# Guests for November and December

The first weeks of the year have filled up. After the kickoff on 2 November, here is who joins us:

- **16 November: Navid Nouhi of [Credoble](https://credoble.com/).** Credoble helps established businesses make their reputation readable to search engines, AI systems and AI agents, a good fit for our first theme on what agents actually see and do.
- **30 November: [Will Binns](https://wbnns.com/)** on Mru, an operating system designed to run for a thousand years without human help.
- **14 December: Patrick Nast of the Formal Protocol Theory SIG** on stigmergic AI safety.

Case pitches move to 25 January.

Guests always go first, before the reading. Sessions run every other Monday at 15:30 UTC on the Protocol Institute Discord, and the full plan is on the [Sessions page](https://protocolsforbusiness.com/sessions/). Three guest slots are still open, on 22 March, 19 April and 28 June. If your work fits one of the themes, [offer a talk](https://protocolsforbusiness.com/research/#speak).
